mapper.insert: INSERT INTO archive_access_application (application_no, applicant_id, department_id, purpose, use_type, start_at, due_at, status, version_no, created_at) VALUES (#{applicationNo}, #{applicantId}, #{departmentId}, #{purpose}, #{useType}, #{startAt}, #{dueAt}, #{status}, #{versionNo}, #{createdAt})
INSERT INTO archive_access_item (application_id, archive_version_id, employee_id, department_id, status) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{versionId}, #{employeeId}, #{departmentId}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.application_no, a.applicant_id, a.department_id, a.purpose, a.use_type, a.start_at, a.due_at, a.status, a.version_no, a.created_at FROM archive_access_application a WHERE a.application_no = #{applicationNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, application_id, archive_version_id, employee_id, department_id, status FROM archive_access_item WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY id

SELECT COALESCE(applicant_employee.name, applicant.username) AS applicant_name, department.name AS department_name FROM archive_access_application a LEFT JOIN sys_user applicant ON applicant.id = a.applicant_id LEFT JOIN employee applicant_employee ON applicant_employee.id = applicant.employee_id LEFT JOIN org_department department ON department.id = a.department_id WHERE a.id = #{applicationId} LIMIT 1

SELECT i.id, i.application_id, i.archive_version_id, v.version_no, i.employee_id, e.employee_no, e.name AS employee_name, i.department_id, department.name AS department_name, d.title AS document_title, i.status FROM archive_access_item i JOIN archive_version v ON v.id = i.archive_version_id JOIN archive_document d ON d.id = v.document_id JOIN employee e ON e.id = i.employee_id LEFT JOIN org_department department ON department.id = i.department_id WHERE i.application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY i.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO archive_access_resolution (application_id, resolved_by_user_id, resolution_note, resolved_at) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{resolvedByUserId}, #{resolutionNote}, #{resolvedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.application_id, r.resolved_by_user_id, COALESCE(resolver_employee.name, resolver.username) AS resolved_by_name, r.resolution_note, r.resolved_at FROM archive_access_resolution r LEFT JOIN sys_user resolver ON resolver.id = r.resolved_by_user_id LEFT JOIN employee resolver_employee ON resolver_employee.id = resolver.employee_id WHERE r.application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY r.resolved_at, r.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO archive_access_decision (application_id, decided_by_user_id, decision, decision_note, decided_at) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{decidedByUserId}, #{decision}, #{decisionNote}, #{decidedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.application_id, d.decided_by_user_id, COALESCE(decider_employee.name, decider.username) AS decided_by_name, d.decision, d.decision_note, d.decided_at FROM archive_access_decision d LEFT JOIN sys_user decider ON decider.id = d.decided_by_user_id LEFT JOIN employee decider_employee ON decider_employee.id = decider.employee_id WHERE d.application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY d.decided_at, d.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO archive_use_record (application_id, operator_id, used_at, returned_at, return_status, remark, returned_by_user_id, handover_to_employee_id) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{operatorId}, #{usedAt}, #{returnedAt}, #{returnStatus}, #{remark}, #{returnedByUserId}, #{handoverToEmployeeId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, application_id, operator_id, used_at, returned_at, return_status, remark, returned_by_user_id, handover_to_employee_id FROM archive_use_record WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND returned_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE archive_use_record SET returned_at = #{returnedAt}, return_status = #{returnStatus}, remark = #{remark}, returned_by_user_id = #{returnedByUserId}, handover_to_employee_id = #{handoverToEmployeeId} WHERE id = #{id} AND returned_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, application_id, operator_id, used_at, returned_at, return_status, remark, returned_by_user_id, handover_to_employee_id FROM archive_use_record WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY used_at, id

SELECT u.id, u.application_id, u.operator_id, COALESCE(operator_employee.name, operator_user.username) AS operator_name, u.used_at, u.returned_at, u.return_status, u.remark, u.returned_by_user_id, COALESCE(returner_employee.name, returner_user.username) AS returned_by_name, u.handover_to_employee_id, handover_employee.employee_no AS handover_to_employee_no, handover_employee.name AS handover_to_employee_name FROM archive_use_record u LEFT JOIN sys_user operator_user ON operator_user.id = u.operator_id LEFT JOIN employee operator_employee ON operator_employee.id = operator_user.employee_id LEFT JOIN sys_user returner_user ON returner_user.id = u.returned_by_user_id LEFT JOIN employee returner_employee ON returner_employee.id = returner_user.employee_id LEFT JOIN employee handover_employee ON handover_employee.id = u.handover_to_employee_id WHERE u.application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY u.used_at, u.id
mapper.update: UPDATE archive_access_application SET status = 'ABNORMAL', version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'IN_USE' AND due_at < #{now} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM archive_use_record u WHERE u.application_id = archive_access_application.id AND u.returned_at IS NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM employee e WHERE e.id = #{employeeId} AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (#{departmentId} IS NULL OR e.department_id = #{departmentId}) ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END
